text: Every aircraft in flight generates wake turbulence, which trails downstream of the wingtips. This can be very dangerous and requires aircraft to maintain a safe separation. When landing behind a larger aircraft, it's important to stay at or above that aircraft's final approach flight path and land beyond its touchdown point. This is especially important in calm wind conditions.
